evidence: frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/realtor/[id]/page.tsx is a DYNAMIC public route (/[locale]/realtor/[id], agent/realtor public profile) but renders 100% static mock data: L13 imports MOCK_AGENT, MOCK_AGENT_LISTINGS, MOCK_AGENT_REVIEWS from ./_mock and L23 `const agent = MOCK_AGENT`, L240 maps MOCK_AGENT_LISTINGS, L335 maps MOCK_AGENT_REVIEWS. The route's `[id]` param is NEVER read (no useParams; the only `.id` references are mock-array `key` props at L242/L337) — so every agent id (e.g. /realtor/123 vs /realtor/456) serves the identical fake agent 'MOCK_AGENT'. This is the same class of defect already fixed elsewhere in this app: app/[locale]/profile/page.tsx's own docstring (L13) records that rendering 'MOCK_PROFILE (Tomas Novotny) to every visitor' was 'a UX bug' and it now calls getMyRealtorProfile(); the /sell wizard was likewise fixed (done finding code-review-reality-web-sell-wizard-no-persist). The realtor profile page was never wired to the reality-server realtor API (lib/realtor-api.ts getMyRealtorProfile / an agent-by-id fetch).

The contact form is also non-functional: L25-31 handleSendMessage only does setMessageSent(true)/setContactOpen(false) after an e.preventDefault() — it never POSTs the visitor's message/lead to the backend, so every 'contact this agent' submission on the public portal is silently discarded while showing the user a success state (L535 messageSent banner).

Compounding SEO impact: the page is `'use client'` (L1) with no generateMetadata and no SSR data — unlike the sibling public listing page (app/[locale]/listings/[slug]/page.tsx) which is a server component with generateMetadata + notFound() for correct 404s. A public, SEO-indexed agent directory page rendered client-only from mock data gives crawlers empty/placeholder content and a 200 for every arbitrary id.

Fix vector: wire the page to a server-side fetch of the agent identified by params.id (mirroring listings/[slug]/page.tsx: resolve host, fetch, parse/validate, notFound() when absent), render real listings/reviews, and wire handleSendMessage to the reality-server lead/contact endpoint with success/error states. Confidence medium: the mock-only rendering and unused `id` param are certain by static read; 'medium' (not high) only because the backend agent-profile endpoint's availability wasn't compile-verified from here.

This is the same i18n-gap class already caught and fixed repeatedly in this exact segment: done findings code-review-reality-web-comparison-view-i18n (ComparisonView.tsx), code-review-reality-web-realtor-mgmt-i18n (components/agency/RealtorManagement.tsx) and code-review-reality-web-agency-errorstate-i18n. Note it DOES carry a `data-i18n="pages.agent-profile.root"` marker (L35), confirming an i18n key namespace was planned but the strings were never wired to next-intl.

Fix vector: add `const t = useTranslations('pages.agent-profile')` and move every hardcoded Slovak string into messages/{en,sk,cs,de}.json under that namespace. Low severity, i18n gap. Confidence medium: 0 useTranslations confirmed by grep; individual missed strings sampled directly.
